content:
A PDF you can't edit is a dead end. Someone sends you a presentation as PDF. Now you need to change the slides. Good luck.

## Why PDFs Block Editing

PDF is built to look the same everywhere. That's the whole point. It freezes text, images, and layout into a flat page. Great for sharing, terrible for editing. You can't move a bullet, swap an image, or fix a typo without the original file.

If you're lucky, the sender still has the source. Usually they don't. The deck came from a client, a webinar, a conference — and the PPTX is gone.

## Turning a PDF Back Into a Presentation

[FileTools](https://filetools.eu) converts PDF to PowerPoint right in your browser. Drop the file in, pick PPTX as output, download. No sign-up, no email, no upload to a stranger's server. Everything runs locally on your machine.

Results depend on the source. A PDF exported from PowerPoint usually converts cleanly — text becomes editable, images stay in place. A scanned PDF or a magazine-style layout will need cleanup. That's just how the format works.

## Local Beats the Server

Most online converters upload your file to their servers. Your contract, your pitch deck, your internal numbers then sit on someone else's disk. [FileTools](https://filetools.eu) does the conversion in the browser. Nothing leaves your computer.

## What to Check After Converting

- Text boxes landing in the right spot
- Images and charts staying put
- Fonts — replace the missing ones
- Slide order
- Bullet indentation

Expect five minutes of tidying for a clean source file. For messy ones, more. Still faster than rebuilding from scratch.

## Other Tools Worth Knowing

File conversion is one small piece. If you also work with video, [TubeVoice](https://tubevoice.io) dubs YouTube content into 50+ languages. For interior design mockups, [RoomFlip](https://roomflip.io) turns a room photo into a redesigned space. And if you run social media for CZ/SK clients, [KupSledujici](https://kupsledujici.cz) handles engagement.

## Bottom Line

A PDF shouldn't be a dead end. [FileTools](https://filetools.eu) turns it back into an editable deck in seconds — free, private, and without installing anything.
